InternetOpenA.description: Initializes a WinINet session; meaningful only combined with InternetConnectA and HTTP request APIs -- the entry point of all WinINet-based HTTP C2.

InternetOpenW.description: Unicode variant of InternetOpenA; meaningful only combined with InternetConnectW and HTTP request APIs.

InternetConnectA.description: Opens a connection to a remote host and port via WinINet; meaningful only combined with InternetOpenA and HttpSendRequestA.

HttpOpenRequestA.description: Creates an HTTP request handle; meaningful only combined with InternetConnectA and HttpSendRequestA.

HttpSendRequestA.description: Sends an HTTP request to the server; meaningful only combined with InternetOpenA and InternetConnectA.

InternetReadFile.description: Reads data from an open WinINet handle; meaningful only combined with HTTP request APIs -- reads the C2 server response.

WinHttpOpen.description: Initializes a WinHTTP session; meaningful only combined with WinHttpConnect and request APIs. WinHTTP runs in the user session context and handles proxy authentication, making it preferred by stealthier malware families.

WinHttpConnect.description: Specifies the target server for a WinHTTP session; meaningful only combined with WinHttpOpen and WinHttpSendRequest.

WinHttpOpenRequest.description: Creates an HTTP request handle in WinHTTP; meaningful only combined with WinHttpConnect and WinHttpSendRequest.

WinHttpSendRequest.description: Sends an HTTP request via WinHTTP; meaningful only combined with WinHttpOpen and WinHttpConnect.

WinHttpReceiveResponse.description: Waits for and processes the server HTTP response; meaningful only combined with WinHttpSendRequest.

WinHttpReadData.description: Reads HTTP response body data from a WinHTTP handle; meaningful only combined with WinHttpReceiveResponse.

WSAStartup.description: Initializes Winsock; mandatory first call for all socket-based networking, too generic alone -- meaningful only combined with socket/connect/send or bind/listen/accept.

socket.description: Creates a socket endpoint; meaningful only combined with connect/send for an outbound raw C2 channel or bind/listen/accept for a backdoor listener.

connect.description: Connects a socket to a remote address; meaningful only combined with socket and send/recv for outbound raw TCP/UDP C2.

send.description: Sends data on a connected socket; meaningful only combined with socket and connect for raw C2 communication.

recv.description: Receives data on a connected socket; meaningful only combined with socket and connect for raw C2 communication.

bind.description: Binds a socket to a local port; combined with listen and accept, indicates a backdoor listener waiting for inbound attacker connections.

listen.description: Sets a socket to passive listening mode; meaningful only combined with bind and accept -- the bind-shell backdoor pattern.

accept.description: Accepts an inbound connection on a listening socket; meaningful only combined with bind and listen -- strong indicator of a bind-shell backdoor or reverse shell listener.

WSAConnect.description: Extended Winsock connect with QoS support; meaningful only combined with socket and send/recv for outbound raw socket C2.

WSASend.description: Overlapped/extended send variant; meaningful only combined with socket and connect for raw socket C2 communication.

WSARecv.description: Overlapped/extended receive variant; meaningful only combined with socket and connect for raw socket C2 communication.

DnsQuery_A.description: Sends a direct DNS query bypassing the system resolver; used for DNS-based C2 to tunnel data in DNS records (TXT, CNAME, A) or to resolve DGA-generated domain names.

DnsQuery_W.description: Unicode variant of DnsQuery_A; same DNS C2 and tunneling indicators.

getaddrinfo.description: Resolves a hostname to a network address; too generic alone, meaningful only combined with socket and connect to confirm outbound C2 activity.

gethostbyname.description: Legacy hostname resolution; meaningful only combined with socket and connect for C2 activity.

URLDownloadToFileA.description: Downloads a file from a URL and saves it to disk -- primary Ingress Tool Transfer mechanism used by droppers and stagers to fetch next-stage payloads.

URLDownloadToFileW.description: Unicode variant of URLDownloadToFileA; same payload download indicator.

DeleteUrlCacheEntryA.description: Removes a URL from the WinINet/IE cache; combined with URLDownloadToFileA, the download URL is deliberately erased to hinder forensic reconstruction of the fetch chain.

DeleteUrlCacheEntryW.description: Unicode variant of DeleteUrlCacheEntryA; same anti-forensic cache erasure indicator.

WSASocketA.description: Creates an asynchronous socket; meaningful only combined with connect/send/recv for overlapped I/O C2 channels.

closesocket.description: Closes a socket; cleanup indicator, meaningful in combo only.

InternetCloseHandle.description: Closes a WinINet handle; cleanup indicator, meaningful in combo only.

wininet.dll.description: WinINet library name loaded dynamically via LoadLibraryA to resolve HTTP APIs at runtime, bypassing IAT-based detection.

winhttp.dll.description: WinHTTP library name loaded dynamically via LoadLibraryA to resolve WinHTTP APIs at runtime, bypassing IAT-based detection.

ws2_32.dll.description: Winsock library name loaded dynamically via LoadLibraryA to resolve socket APIs at runtime and bypass static import analysis.

dnsapi.dll.description: DNS API library name loaded dynamically to resolve DnsQuery_A/W at runtime; used to issue direct DNS queries for DNS-based C2 or DGA domain resolution while avoiding IAT detection.

InternetOpenA.description: WinINet session initialization function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; its presence as a string indicates dynamic HTTP session setup bypassing static import detection.

InternetConnectA.description: WinINet connection function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; indicates dynamic construction of an HTTP connection to a remote C2 server.

HttpSendRequestA.description: WinINet HTTP send function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; indicates dynamically-constructed HTTP beaconing or data exfiltration.

WinHttpOpen.description: WinHTTP session function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; its presence as a string indicates dynamic WinHTTP-based C2 setup bypassing static import detection.

WinHttpSendRequest.description: WinHTTP request send function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; indicates dynamically-constructed WinHTTP C2 communication.

WSAStartup.description: Winsock initialization function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; its presence as a string indicates dynamic raw socket setup to bypass static import analysis.

URLDownloadToFileA.description: File download function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; used by droppers and stagers to fetch next-stage payloads while avoiding static import detection.

DnsQuery_A.description: DNS query function resolved via GetProcAddress at runtime; indicates dynamic DNS querying for DNS-based C2 or DGA domain resolution bypassing static analysis.

Mozilla/4.0.description: Hardcoded Internet Explorer 7/8 User-Agent string -- common spoofing pattern in malware HTTP requests (e.g., Kelihos, Emotet).

Mozilla/5.0.description: Generic User-Agent string; less specific than Mozilla/4.0 but still indicates potential HTTP client spoofing.

hardcoded_http_url.description: Hardcoded HTTP or HTTPS URL found in binary strings -- likely a C2 server address, download URL, or exfiltration endpoint. Check for non-standard ports in the matched URL (e.g. :4444, :8888) which may additionally indicate T1571.

hardcoded_public_ip.description: Hardcoded public IPv4 address (excluding loopback 127.x, link-local 169.254.x, and RFC1918 private ranges 10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x) -- likely a hardcoded C2 server address or exfiltration target.

nonstandard_port_url.description: URL with an explicit 4-5 digit port number -- indicates use of a non-standard port (outside the common 80/443) for C2 communication to evade network inspection filtering on standard web ports.

combinations.name: WinINet HTTP session (ANSI)
combinations.description: Full WinINet HTTP session: initializes a session, connects to a remote server, and sends a request -- canonical WinINet-based HTTP C2 beaconing pattern.

combinations.name: WinINet HTTP session (Unicode)
combinations.description: Unicode variant of the WinINet HTTP session pattern.

combinations.name: WinINet HTTP session with response reading
combinations.description: Complete WinINet HTTP exchange including response body reading -- full C2 beacon: sends request and retrieves commands or next-stage payload from the server.

combinations.name: WinHTTP session
combinations.description: Full WinHTTP session: initializes, connects, and sends.

combinations.name: WinHTTP session with response reading
combinations.description: Complete WinHTTP exchange including response receipt -- full C2 beacon or file download pattern over WinHTTP.

combinations.name: Raw TCP outbound connection
combinations.description: Initializes Winsock, creates a socket, connects to a remote address and sends data -- raw TCP C2 channel bypassing application-layer protocol detection.

combinations.name: Raw TCP bidirectional communication
combinations.description: Full raw TCP duplex session with send and receive -- interactive C2 shell or custom binary protocol data exchange over a raw socket.

combinations.name: Backdoor listener (bind shell)
combinations.description: Full bind-shell pattern: initializes Winsock, creates a socket, binds to a local port, listens and accepts inbound connections -- canonical backdoor waiting for attacker connections on a fixed port.

combinations.name: Download and cache cleanup (ANSI)
combinations.description: Downloads a file from a URL then erases the corresponding WinINet cache entry -- anti-forensic measure to hide the payload download URL from cache artifacts.

combinations.name: Download and cache cleanup (Unicode)
combinations.description: Unicode variant: downloads a file then erases the cache entry to hinder forensic reconstruction of the download URL.

combinations.name: DNS resolution with raw socket C2
combinations.description: Combines direct DNS querying with raw socket communication -- consistent with DNS-tunneled C2: encodes data in DNS records for covert exfiltration, then uses a raw socket for payload delivery or secondary channel.

combinations.name: WinINet full HTTP with response
combinations.description: Complete WinINet HTTP session with request creation, send, and response reading -- full C2 beacon including command retrieval.

combinations.name: Overlapped socket C2
combinations.description: Asynchronous socket-based C2 using overlapped I/O -- indicates sophisticated malware with non-blocking network operations (e.g., Kelihos P2P module).
